description: Submit a wallet-signed Metaplex metadata tx. Structural re-verifier pins the metadata ix + fee.

lastValidBlockHeight.description: The `lastValidBlockHeight` returned alongside the unsigned tx by /build. Past this block height the tx can no longer land.

signedTransaction.description: The base64 VersionedTransaction returned by the matching /build call, signed with your key. Do not submit it yourself; this endpoint submits it.

name: solknife_token_metadata_execute
